description: Deterministic failures found during implementation; not paid runs and not pooled into historical benchmark results.

iterations.finding: Integral minLength and related JSON Schema keywords depended on int/long storage.
iterations.correction: Use integral numeric value and Int64 bounds; preserve constraints.

iterations.finding: Typed agent response schema copied uniqueItems into an unsupported strict profile and nested to depth 14.
iterations.correction: Keep uniqueness in full semantic validation and factor nested structured bindings into definitions.

iterations.finding: Definition pruning made count-based schema names collide; the projected output acquired an array schema.
iterations.correction: Allocate unused definition names and collapse aliases without overwriting definitions.

iterations.finding: Explicitly inspected retained contracts exceeded the original 24,000-token request ceiling.
iterations.correction: Lossless definition factoring, alias collapse and omitted empty context; unchanged limits and receipts.

iterations.finding: A transport error appended MODEL_DISPATCH_UNVERIFIABLE and changed the pending version-5 repair authority.
iterations.correction: Exclude transport-only evidence from version-5 permission authority; preserve original schema, budgets and versions 1–4.

iterations.finding: Published Browser configuration has KeepBrowserOpen=true, so the fixture cleanup oracle failed for all seven variants.
iterations.correction: Pin KeepBrowserOpen=false, zero slow/hold time and loopback confinement only in disposable test process configuration; no host policy or production setting changed.

iterations.finding: The retained agent evidence schema required presence of exit_code but not success.
iterations.correction: The new negative fixture explicitly declares const:0 and returns 1; compiler and execution then enforce that accepted declaration.

iterations.finding: A producer feeding an invoked group input or enclosing loop control was rejected as disconnected in four compiled regressions.
iterations.correction: Follow consumed group arguments, captured values and enclosing control prerequisites; exclude unreachable callers and retain directed traversal so unrelated siblings and unused arguments remain rejected.

iterations.finding: Both Linux CI test jobs failed all seven local product variants because the fixture inherited multiple host Kestrel endpoints. Reproduced locally by injecting two Kestrel endpoint environment values.
iterations.correction: Clear ambient fixture configuration and bind one loopback ephemeral listener. Keep production configuration unchanged and install Chromium system dependencies in both CI hosts.
iterations.recheck: All seven variants passed locally with the same two conflicting ambient endpoints.
